facts.text: Serve the mains when Giselle cooks breakfast in Robert's apartment.
facts.why: The transcript has someone say they made breakfast but never shows Giselle cooking. The scene the plot does show in Robert's apartment is Giselle singing the city animals into cleaning it.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Giselle sings the city animals into cleaning Robert's apartment.

facts.text: I made dinner with help from the city animals. The pigeons set the table, the rats did the dishes, and Robert still looks worried.
facts.why: The animals help Giselle clean the apartment, not make dinner. The moviemistakes quote page has none of this and no lines from Pip or Nancy. It reads as an invented quote.
facts.fix: Use a note: I cleaned the whole apartment with help from the city animals, even the cockroaches. Robert still looks worried.

fix_note.text: I cleaned the whole apartment with help from the city animals, even the cockroaches. Robert still looks worried.

facts.text: Breakfast made with help from the cockroaches.
facts.why: The cockroaches are among the city animals in the cleaning song in Robert's kitchen, not helping with any breakfast.
facts.fix: Cleaned up with help from the cockroaches.

vibe.verdict: A tiki island layout on a New York fairy tale, with a cue and note that drift from what the film shows.
missing: That's How You Know in Central Park (the song)
Giselle's dress made from Robert's curtains (the apartment)
The city animals cleaning up, cockroaches and all (Robert's apartment)
Narissa as the dragon at the ball (the finale)
Edward climbing out of the manhole in Times Square
Robert and Giselle waltzing at the ball
ideas: Swap the 'Island hopping' tiki layout for a storybook meets Manhattan look in pink and blue.
Swap 'Lagoon Coolers' for 'From the Wishing Well'.
Swap the 'Pip's acorn nuts' note for 'Pip can't tell you how good they are. He is in New York.'
Swap 'Pink meringues' note for 'Sweet enough for a curtain dress and a happy ending.'
